purpose: Exposure support check before any action-value fit. These are historical development roots. Reuse every independently signed archived pair, without selecting by the outcome.
pairs: All 108 cases and all 18 terrain hashes of joint_response_critic_dev/signed_roots.json.gz intersected by exact case with paired_response_prefix/signed.json.gz. Reconstruct public Feat chronologically from the archived physical joint actions of the historical parent. Cross-check physical identities, input tape hash, both whole candidate teams' commands, root enemy choice and audited terminal delta. Do not play the original.
inputs: Current quantized old and learned bc69b55e student carbon planes, with float pixel scale 100/255. Only workers or bases whose actual public command differs between the two alternatives can convey carbon evidence about the choice. For a worker command compare destination carbon, four-neighbor mean (the prospective plantation income input), and mean carbon on the union of shortest toroidal routes from that destination to any nearest own base including endpoints. For a changed recruit/pass at a base, use carbon statistics of the base and its four neighbors, gated on recruited role so hold remains distinct. Use the signed joint commands literally. Also count nonzero boardwide differences, and roots with ANY changed cell inside either option's neighborhood or route, to report generous upper bounds.
identifiability: Sufficient support to register a small action head requires non-identical option-contrast carbon features (>1e-6 carbon units) on at least 24 of 108 roots, spread over at least 8 of 18 terrains, with both terminal signs present on >=3 maps each. These minimal support checks are conservative for a terrain-held comparison, not a significance threshold. Report strictly positive word-level / per-map exposure, >=1.0 carbon unit sensitivity and outside-estimator-training-terrain subgroup. No threshold expansion or wider search after inspection. If inadequate do not fit a head; list genuine available supervision and what new outcomes would be required. An eligible design must be preregistered separately before any fitting.
outputs: Per-root public support with both official measured margins and alternative minus parent; sign and support counts by physical terrain; time buckets; and overlap with the frozen estimator's training maps. Success on labels alone cannot establish a causal gain or a whole-game win.
